description: Defines a utility class 'string_utils' with static methods for string manipulation, including trimming, splitting, case-insensitive comparison, hex conversion, and string copying, within the 'beerocks' namespace.

classes.name: string_utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static string manipulation methods.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Trim whitespace from the start of a string in place.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Trim whitespace from the end of a string in place.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trim whitespace from both ends of a string in place.

methods.name: ltrimmed_substr
methods.description: Get a substring trimmed from the start.

methods.name: rtrimmed_substr
methods.description: Get a substring trimmed from the end.

methods.name: trimmed_substr
methods.description: Get a substring trimmed from both ends.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Check if a string contains only whitespace characters.

methods.name: bool_str
methods.description: Convert a boolean value to 'true' or 'false' string.

methods.name: str_split
methods.description: Split a string into a vector of substrings based on a delimiter.

methods.name: endswith
methods.description: Check if a string ends with a given suffix.

methods.name: stoi
methods.description: Convert a string to int64_t, with optional file and line info.

methods.name: hex_to_bytes
methods.description: Convert a hex string into a container of bytes or characters.

methods.name: int_to_hex_string
methods.description: Convert an integer to a hex string with specified digit length.

methods.name: bytes_string_to_string
methods.description: Convert a hex-encoded byte string to a human-readable string.

methods.name: copy_string
methods.description: Copy a string from source to destination buffer.
